title: Automate your sales pipeline
description: Find leads, prep your calls, transcribe them, and follow up automatically.
introduction: Picture a sales hire who finds the right companies, reads up on every account before your call, writes the follow-up while you're still saying goodbye, and never lets a lead go cold. That's what Strawberry can become for your team.

ChatGPT and Claude can explain how to prospect. Strawberry does the prospecting. It's a free browser with an AI companion built in, working inside LinkedIn, your inbox, and your CRM, logged in as you.

sections.title: Why a browser, not a chatbot

blocks.text: Chatbots only know what you paste in. Strawberry works where your leads are.

items: Uses LinkedIn and your CRM while you're logged in.
Reads dozens of pages at once, not one click at a time.
Works in real tabs you can watch and take over.

blocks.text: In our test of 12 real-world tasks, Strawberry scored 99.2 out of 100. Perplexity's Comet scored 90.8 and ChatGPT Atlas 73.3.

items: Enrich a list you already have with decision-makers, emails, and company size.
Keep the pipeline healthy: stale leads, duplicates, and contacts who changed jobs.
Create a Slack channel for every new deal, with the right people already in it.
Pin a live pipeline dashboard as a tab.
Make a one-pager or a short deck for a specific account, in your brand.

blocks.text: Save what works as a team skill and every rep's companion sources, preps, and follows up the same way. Put the steady parts on Routines and your pipeline gets worked every morning, even when nobody remembered to.
